newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 200 MW peak, firm power for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 200 MW peak, firm power for Tuesday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 200 megawatts (MW) of firm power during peak demand hours on Tuesday at $12.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest delivery and at $13.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales, the agency said Monday.
For today, BPA had offered 400 MW of peak firm power at the same prices.
Offers of unlimited peak firm power during light load hours on Tuesday remained unchanged at $9.00 a MWh.
Tuesday non-firm power for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 was unchanged at $9.00 for all deliveries, while deliveries during hours ending 0600 and 2300 were offered at $10.00.
BPA did not offer any non-firm power during peak hours on Tuesday.
